# Kotlin Sync Driver - (current)

> The MongoDB Kotlin Sync Driver is the official MongoDB driver for synchronous Kotlin applications, covering connecting, CRUD operations, aggregation, and more.

- [Aggregation Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/aggregation.md): Learn how to use the Kotlin Sync driver to perform aggregation operations.
- [Aggregation Expression Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/aggregation/agg-exp-ops.md)
- [API Documentation](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/api.md)
- [Run a MongoDB Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/atlas-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Search in the MongoDB Kotlin Sync Driver.
- [Run a MongoDB Vector Search Query](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/atlas-vector-search.md): Learn about how to use MongoDB Vector Search in the Kotlin Sync driver.
- [Use Builders Code Pattern](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/builders.md)
- [Use Builders with Data Classes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/builders/builders-data-classes.md)
- [Connect to MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect.md): Learn how to connect to MongoDB by using the Kotlin Sync driver, including how to specify connection targets and connection options for your application.
- [Specify Connection Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options.md)
- [Connection Pools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options/connection-pools.md)
- [Limit Server Execution Time](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options/csot.md)
- [Compress Network Traffic](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options/network-compression.md): Enable network compression while using the Kotlin Sync driver to reduce the data transferred and transfer costs by using the Snappy, Zlib, or Zstandard algorithms.
- [Customize Server Selection](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options/server-selection.md)
- [Connect With Stable API](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-options/stable-api.md)
- [Choose a Connection Target](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-targets.md)
- [Connection Troubleshooting](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/connection-troubleshooting.md)
- [Create a MongoClient](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/connect/mongoclient.md)
- [CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud.md): Learn how to use Kotlin Sync driver to read and write MongoDB data.
- [Bulk Write Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/bulk-write.md)
- [Configure CRUD Operations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/configure.md): Configure Kotlin Sync Driver CRUD operations with read and write concerns, read preferences, retryable reads and writes, collation, and codec options.
- [Delete Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/delete.md)
- [Insert Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/insert.md)
- [Query Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/query.md): Learn how to use Kotlin Sync driver to read data from MongoDB.
- [Count Documents](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/crud/query/count.md)

- [Custom Data Types](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/data-formats/custom-types.md): Learn how to use the Kotlin Sync driver to encode and decode custom types, including defining type codecs, using type registries, and implementing fallback encoders.
- [Document Data Format: Data Classes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/kotlin/kotlin-sync-driver/current/data-formats/data-format-data-class.md)
